chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 312: Ji Ning Survives an Assassin and Gains the Lotus Dharma-Vase
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning survives a Loose Immortal's deadly ambush and earns the respect of the Grand Xia capital's elite. A lotus-shaped treasure and a humiliated rival follow.
og_title: The Lotus Dharma-Vase – Desolate Era Ch. 312
og_description: Ji Ning steps from a shattered formation as the assassin-killer. Fame, a royal invitation, and an elegant apology treasure await.
twitter_title: The Lotus Dharma-Vase – Desolate Era Ch. 312
twitter_description: Ji Ning survives a Loose Immortal's ambush, wins the capital's respect, and receives a lotus treasure. Xiao Lang eats crow.

lore_anchors.definition: A second, independent soul body created by splitting one's consciousness and cultivating a separate physical form. In Desolate Era, it functions as a combat multiplier and survival backup, allowing its owner to fight and train in parallel with their true body.

A cultivator whose soul survived heavenly tribulation but whose physical body was destroyed, leaving them in a vulnerable, decaying state. They are immensely powerful but face periodic, increasingly lethal tribulations every 100,000–500,000 years.

A high-level sealing formation used to isolate a battlefield from external interference. It was deployed by the Floating Cloud Immortal to prevent anyone from rescuing Ji Ning during the assassination attempt.
A treasure bottle engraved with lotus runes, gifted by Zhuanshui Xiaolou. It is not a powerful weapon but contains deep lotus-related mysteries that can inspire a cultivator's Dao comprehension.
A combined technique used by thirty-six Loose Immortals of the Zhuanshui clan, forming a massive spectral serpent. Its appearance signaled to the Imperial Guard that serious violence was underway.
A Vice-Commander of the Grand Xia Imperial Guard and a member of the royal Xiamang clan. He is portrayed as playful and unpretentious, but sharp enough to recognize real talent.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Zhuanshui Xiaolou give Ji Ning a lotus vase?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As an apology for the security failure at his establishment. The vase is not a powerful weapon but contains lotus runes that might help Ji Ning improve his own lotus-based sword technique.
A Vice-Commander of the Imperial Guard and a member of the Grand Xia royal clan. He's a playful, confident figure who befriends Ji Ning after the assassination attempt.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Xiao Lang leave in humiliation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Earlier in the chapter, Xiao Lang had openly mocked Ji Ning and told him to go home. After Ji Ning kills a top-tier Loose Immortal, Xiao Lang's earlier boasts look ridiculous, and both Fairy Boyan and Xiamang Hong publicly call him out.
